scope: Two vendored object-collection/summary modules read whole and pinned. Only exact AST-extracted filter body executed, with deterministic len size-provider seam; not whole module/profiling integration.
findings: filter starts empty result and populates only when Type provided; no-filter or size-only calls return empty. Size min uses < instead of >= and max uses > instead of <=. Exact function control reproduced empty result for valid range.
get_objects invokes gc.collect before snapshot and excludes frame objects by default; snapshot does not describe precollection memory or all process allocations.
_remove_duplicates uses id(item), which is appropriate object identity while list retains references. This is not content equality and must not be reused as a file-content dedup key.
get_referents recursively extends same list while iterating it; indirect levels/cyclic graphs need bounded traversal qualification. No such object graph executed.

Summary labels collapse objects by textual type/function/module representation; equal labels are aggregate bins, not equal object identity. get_diff implementation computes right-left despite docstring saying subtract right from left.
